post.title: How a $300 deposit can turn into a credit history
post.ig:
No credit? Your own $300 can become your limit.
A secured card's deposit usually becomes its credit limit, and many issuers report your payments to the credit bureaus like a regular card.
Payment history is 35% of a FICO Score. Our math: a $90 balance on a $300 limit is 30% utilization; $30 is 10%. Lower utilization is generally better.
To score you, FICO needs at least one account open six months or more and at least one account reported in the last six months. Close or upgrade in good standing and the deposit is generally refunded (issuer terms vary). Before applying, check that the card reports to all 3 bureaus.
The CFPB estimated 7 million US adults had no credit record in December 2020.
Sources: CFPB (June 2025), myFICO, Federal Reserve (Dec 2024).
